cacheState.note: Network.setCacheDisabled(true) + Network.clearBrowserCache() before every navigation, so every sample starts from an empty HTTP cache.

device.dprAssertion: window.devicePixelRatio is read after every navigation; a sample whose effective DPR is not 3 is marked invalid and excluded from the aggregates.

procedure: One discarded warm-up page load per scenario and run.
Every sample uses a FRESH browser target (new document) inside a dedicated browser context (empty localStorage/cookies), with the final mobile configuration applied before any navigation.

Emulation.setDeviceMetricsOverride(390x844, deviceScaleFactor 3, mobile true), Emulation.setTouchEmulationEnabled(5 points) and one constant mobile user agent are applied before the first navigation and never changed afterwards.
Emulation.setCPUThrottlingRate(4) and Network.emulateNetworkConditions (Slow 4G class) are applied before the navigation of every sample.
Page.addScriptToEvaluateOnNewDocument installs the PerformanceObservers (largest-contentful-paint, layout-shift, longtask) before the document loads.
After the load event the harness waits a fixed settle window and then reads the navigation/resource/observer data out of the page with Runtime.evaluate.
CDP Performance.getMetrics is sampled before and after the navigation and reported as a delta (TaskDuration, ScriptDuration).

build.note: The build is never rebuilt by this harness. A temporary copy of the existing dist tree is served so that a concurrent rebuild in the same checkout cannot change the measured bytes; the SHA-256 fingerprints below prove which bytes were served.

metricSources.browser-instrumentation: PerformanceNavigationTiming, PerformanceResourceTiming and PerformanceObserver (largest-contentful-paint, layout-shift, longtask) read out of the page with Runtime.evaluate.
metricSources.cdp: Chrome DevTools Protocol: Performance.getMetrics (TaskDuration, ScriptDuration, LayoutDuration, RecalcStyleDuration) and Network.requestWillBeSent (request counting, host attribution).

methodology.outlierRule: A sample is flagged as an outlier when |value - median| > 2 * MAD, where MAD is the median absolute deviation of the successful samples of the same scenario (and the same metric) across all runs. When MAD is 0 the rule flags nothing.

labels.lcpMs: Largest Contentful Paint candidate start time (browser instrumentation).
labels.cls: Cumulative Layout Shift, layout-shift entries with hadRecentInput excluded.
labels.longTaskBlockingApproximationMs: Long-task blocking approximation = sum of (longtask duration - 50). This is NOT Lighthouse Total Blocking Time (TBT).
labels.mainThreadTaskMs: CDP Performance.getMetrics TaskDuration delta for the navigation (main-thread task time).
labels.scriptDurationMs: CDP Performance.getMetrics ScriptDuration delta for the navigation.
labels.jsTransferBytes: Sum of PerformanceResourceTiming transferSize over resources classified as scripts (encodedBodySize is reported separately as a fallback).
labels.requestCount: CDP Network.requestWillBeSent count during the navigation (document + subresources).

notMeasured: Lighthouse metrics (this harness is not Lighthouse and reports no Lighthouse score).
Real Total Blocking Time (TBT) as Lighthouse defines it.
INP / interaction responsiveness (no interaction is performed; only a long-task approximation is reported).
Field data (CrUX, RUM, real-user Core Web Vitals).
Cross-origin resource transfer sizes are 0 without Timing-Allow-Origin; third-party request counts are still reported.
